sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Admin scoring handler
sections.what: Checks the caller is an admin, reads the scorecard, scores the match, and returns a message saying whether anything new was written.
sections.why: The comment says rerunning is safe, so an admin can press it again without doubling points.
sections.watch_out: Admin access depends entirely on the check in the admin library, so a weak check there would open this route to everyone.

summary: Lets an admin score a finished match from its real scorecard, writing the results to a score ledger.
purpose: Turns real match results into fantasy points.
why: The comment says the ledger is append-only and rerunning is safe, so a score is never doubled.
how: 1) Checks the request is from an admin. 2) Checks the body against the scoring schema. 3) Scores the match through the scoring service. 4) Returns a message saying the match was scored or already scored.
inputs: A POST with a match id and each player's stats, checked by the scoring schema.
outputs: A JSON message with the count of events written.
risks: A wrong scorecard produces wrong points, and per the comment the ledger is append-only, so a mistake must be fixed by a new entry.
debug: If scores look wrong, compare the stats sent with the scorecard, then check the scoring service and the ledger for that version.
